what: QoreChain refuses a relayed MsgExecuteEVM whose relaying transaction provisions less gas than the gas_limit the linked key signed, before the spending rule is asked. Found in the first compromised-agent run on InvoiceDeskV4 (lib/agent.mjs relayed non-payment calls with 650k-1M signed, ~808k provisioned); fixed by provisioning the same pair for every request.

rows.label: injection: fUSD.transfer(Mallory, 20)
rows.why: permission denied - the authenticator lacks the permission this message requires (check the permission_schema) (failed to execute message; message index: 0: the transaction provisions 808336 gas for the call, less than the signed gas_limit 1000000: authenticator not permitted for this action)

rows.why: permission denied - the authenticator lacks the permission this message requires (check the permission_schema) (failed to execute message; message index: 0: the transaction provisions 808018 gas for the call, less than the signed gas_limit 1000000: authenticator not permitted for this action)
